zh-Hans: 与服务端 v0.9.4-pre7 一起发布：先升级探针，或和服务端同时升级
新增 --redact-domains 和 sanitize.redact_domains：隐藏你列出的域名及其子域名，列表只存本机
hide_hostname 打开时，主机名里的域名部分也一起隐藏
磁盘温度传感器带上设备名（nvme0、sda），多块盘不再只报一块
脱敏修正：sudo 密码提示不再遮下一行；the password is 后面的密码和 YAML 块写法的值会遮住
en: Released with server v0.9.4-pre7: update the agent first, or together with the server
New --redact-domains and sanitize.redact_domains hide the domains you list and their subdomains; the list stays on the machine
With hide_hostname, the hostname's domain part is hidden too
Disk temperature sensors carry their device names (nvme0, sda), so every disk is reported
Redaction fixes: sudo password prompts no longer hide the next line; the password is X and YAML block values are hidden
